description: Whether a pasted decklist is legal, without saving it: in one format, or in every format when none is given. Takes the list as text ("4 Lightning Bolt" a line; a "Commander" and a "Sideboard" section, or *CMDR*, as the sites write them), any language Scryfall prints. Each verdict has legal and its issues (severity error or warning, code, message: size, copy limits, banned and restricted cards, commander and colour identity, the companion's condition). A list with a card in not_found is never called legal: the not_checked issue names those cards; say so. read_as names a card read in another language. Read from the card catalogue only; it works before the user signs in. For a deck already in Reliquary, deck_health reports more (missing cards, shared copies, proxies).
